item.text: The exporter stops when a page has fewer visible records than `pageSize`, but deleted records can make a page short even when more records remain. Project exports mask this with a hardcoded larger page size. I’ll make pagination follow continuation bookmarks and remove that workaround.

item.text:
Fixed CAT-284. Exports now follow continuation bookmarks until `null`, so deleted records no longer cause early termination. The reported case exports both `i-1` and `i-3`.

Removed the project-specific page-size workaround. All 5 tests pass, including regressions for short pages, empty pages, and empty-string bookmarks.
